items.text: La Cannabinothèque, run by the association ChanGE with the municipality of Vernier as its main partner, sells cannabis to enrolled participants from a single outlet in Vernier. Planned from June 2023 to June 2027, with up to 1,080 participants.

Under the federal pilot-trial rules, only adults who live in this canton and can show they already use cannabis may enrol. Participants may use the products only themselves: no passing them on and no use in publicly accessible places. Visitors from outside the canton can't enrol or buy, and the national cannabis ban applies to everyone outside the trials. Each trial is limited to five years, with one extension of up to two years possible; the legal basis for the trials ends on 14 May 2031.

laws.rule: The canton of Geneva charges one tourist stay tax (taxe de séjour) across the canton: CHF 4.25 per person per night whatever the type of accommodation (about A$7.34), and CHF 2.50 at campsites (about A$4.32). It applies to adults and minors, and the hotel, holiday rental, hostel or campsite collects it from guests. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = CHF 0.5789.
